description: Per-recipient key-wrap for an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record. Symmetric record key encrypted under a Signal session between sender DID and recipient DID. Recipient enumerates this collection in their own PDS to discover read-caps. One keyWrap record per (encrypted record, recipient) pair. Per ADR-2605181100.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the encrypted record this key unlocks. Optional — recipient can also discover records by enumerating keyId matches.

ciphertext.description: libsignal-encrypted (symmetric record key). Decrypts via the established Signal session between sender and recipient.

signalSessionId.description: Identifier of the Signal session under which `ciphertext` was produced. Recipient SDK uses this to select the correct session for decrypt.

pqSuite.description: Post-quantum hybrid suite identifier (ADR-2606111300). When present, the wrap key derives from the pqh-v1 hybrid handshake below instead of a pre-established session.

pqX25519Ephemeral.description: pqh-v1: sender's ephemeral X25519 public key (32 bytes).

pqMlkemCiphertext.description: pqh-v1: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) ciphertext against the recipient's published pqMlkemPublicKey (1088 bytes).
